evals.name: full-product-launch
evals.prompt: We're launching a paid analytics add-on next quarter. Build the full plan: positioning, pricing, onboarding, launch content, and success metrics.
evals.expected_output: Intent clarified before planning (why / who / success / non-goals), then a tree.json with 3-9 branches and nodes that each have judge and next, generated into the configured vault. Chat reply reports only changes, next step, and decisions needed.

evals.name: lightweight-small-task
evals.prompt: Write a one-page memo recommending whether we should migrate our docs from Notion to a static site.
evals.expected_output: A lightweight tree (1 branch, at most 3 nodes) rather than a full program tree; the memo is produced and the tree records the recommendation and what remains open.

evals.name: mid-task-goal-change
evals.prompt: Change of plan: the board cut the budget in half. Update the launch plan we've been working on.
evals.expected_output: The existing tree is updated, not replaced: a calibration entry with kind 范围 or 目标 records the old and new constraint, affected node states change, a snapshot is written, and the growth page shows what changed this round.

evals.name: overbuilt-process
evals.prompt: Our ops team wants a three-stage approval process, a progress dashboard, and a weekly report to track every task. Build it.
evals.expected_output: Requirements are challenged before building (who uses each artifact, what disappears if it is removed); removed items are recorded in tree.json's deleted array; unvalidated steps are not automated; the root page's 算法关 section shows the deletion record and the automation threshold.
